title: Functoriality of the etale torsor classification of H1
statement: Use, for abelian sheaves on small etale sites, the canonical bijection $H^1(T_{\mathrm{Et}},G)\cong\{\text{isomorphism classes of }G\text{-torsors}\}$ of [lem-sc-torsor-h1] (torsors as in [def-sc-gm-torsor]). (1) Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and $u^*:H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},G)\to H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},u^{-1}G)$ the pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. For a $G$-torsor $T$, the inverse image $u^{-1}T$ of the sheaf of sets $T$ (the sheafified presheaf inverse image, as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]) is a $u^{-1}G$-torsor, and $u^*$ sends the class of $T$ to the class of $u^{-1}T$. (2) Let $S$ be a scheme and $\varphi:G\to G'$ a morphism of abelian sheaves on $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$, with $H^1(\varphi):H^1(S_{\mathrm{Et}},G)\to H^1(S_{\mathrm{Et}},G')$ the induced map of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. Then $H^1(\varphi)$ sends the class of a $G$-torsor $T$ to the class of the $G'$-torsor $T\wedge^GG'$, the sheafification of $(T\times G')/G$ with $g\cdot(t,g')=(g\cdot t,\varphi(g)^{-1}g')$ and $G'$ acting on the second factor.

proof.text: Use injectiveSequence_shortExact and exists_equiv_lifts from [lem-sc-torsor-h1] to choose a global quotient section s and an equivariant identification of T with its lifting torsor. Use [lem-sc-etale-inverse-image-lifting-torsor] to identify the set inverse image with the lifts of the pulled-back section; this supplies the required sheaf isomorphism and its equivariance.

Rewrite both classes with classH1_lifts and H.delta_apply from [lem-sc-torsor-h1]. Expand cohomologyMap as exact-functor transport of Ext. Mathlib Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and Ext.mapExactFunctor_extClass transport the boundary extension. The degree-zero identity [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero] identifies the initial Ext-zero class with the pulled-back quotient section. Ext.comp_assoc now gives the pullback equality.

Choose the contracted-product torsor and its presentation by [lem-sc-etale-contracted-product-exists]. The map t to q(t,0) is natural by quotient_natural. Substituting h=phi(g) in quotient_invariant and then using quotient_vadd with h=0 proves q(g+ t,0)=phi(g)+q(t,0).
Apply the already proved classH1_eq_map_of_equivariant from [lem-sc-torsor-h1] to this map. Symmetry yields the coefficient-change equality.
